method: All 115 page thumbnails visually inspected using view_image; five selected dense/table/formula/illustration/reference pages independently rendered from the final PDF at 1600-pixel height for closer visual inspection.

full_page_checks.finding: Header, month heading, paragraph and table rows have clear separation. All cells wrap within borders; bottom row and footer fit.
Dense mathematical formulas wrap within the third column; table lines and cell text do not overlap or clip.

full_page_checks.kind: Long P30 integers and polynomial proof
full_page_checks.finding: Long integer wraps onto the next line and remains within margins. Formula/proof/box and subsequent entry heading are separated. No cropped text or missing glyphs observed.
Plot titles, labels, legends and captions remain clear and separate. Chart boundaries and caption lines fit page margins.
Bold reference names and URL lines fit within page margins, with consistent spacing and no collision with footer.

scope: Visual QA of final rendering only; no PDF, builder or source was modified. Contact-sheet inspection establishes layout coverage, with closer inspection concentrated on selected dense pages rather than a full-size reading of every page.
